search_text: published ZDI-21-1594 ZDI-CAN-14080 Veritas Enterprise Vault EVStgOfflineOpns Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2021-12-23 CVE-2021-44681 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-44681 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Veritas'] ['Enterprise Vault'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Veritas Enterprise Vault. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within EVStgOfflineOpns.exe. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the Enterprise Vault Storage Service. Veritas has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://www.veritas.com/content/support/en_US/security/VTS21-003 ['2021-08-13 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2021-12-23 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Markus Wulftange (@mwulftange) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-21-1594/
title: Veritas Enterprise Vault EVStgOfflineOpns Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Veritas Enterprise Vault.
